title: Management Practices and Resilience to Shocks: Evidence from COVID-19
eligible_reason: Not eligible. The design is a difference-in-difference with repeated cross sections around a single event (Italian lockdown, interview week 12-13 of 2020): the treatment is a continuous standardized management score (ZscoreMOPS) interacted with a post-lockdown indicator (inter_lockdown), with sector x post and firm-type x post fixed effects and time-varying firm controls. No binary treatment, no staggered adoption, no unit fixed effects (each firm is surveyed once). Data are Bank of Italy internal survey microdata and are not shipped.
design_notes: analysis_t4.do: reghdfe v539_trim (expected 2020 sales growth) ZscoreMOPS inter_lockdown [controls] if week_invind!=12 & week!=13, absorb(sect_3dig#dummy_post_lockdown week_invind v3#dummy_post_lockdown inter_type) cluster(sect_3dig); columns split pre/post; Dsales (realized growth) in columns 6-7. Table 5: areg sw20 (smart working) on ZscoreMOPS with controls. Table 3: conditional logit. Only log files and do-files are shipped; README states the do-files 'can only be run internally in the Bank of Italy system'.
data_provenance: not shipped (Bank of Italy INVIND/SONDTEL/ISECO surveys, INPS, CERVED)
data_files: none (replication_data_ms.dta referenced in do-files is not included); LOG_FILES/*.txt show the Stata output
screener_notes: Flags (diff-in-diff, two-way fixed effects, cite Roth et al. 2023) reflect the single-shock DiD with a continuous treatment. Screened from package only.
